text:
nina: Pushed a fresh draft of the launch blog here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-2026-draft — need quick checks on hero angle, benchmark wording, and CTA routing before I lock.

oliver: reading now. quick ask: split CTAs so self-serve traffic goes to signup and enterprise leads hit demo form.

rebecca: noted. legal flagged the phrase 'industry-best latency' — prefer 'leading median latency' + link to methodology.

prashant: bench numbers we can cite publicly: median ~58ms, p95 ~120ms on 2k token gen in our hosted tests. I'll DM ops for a sanitized methodology link.

ux: hero art: use assets/illustrations/2026/launch-abstract.svg. design can export OG sizes if we get a final image choice.

nina: thanks — can someone paste a tiny JSON CTA mapping for web ops?

oliver: quick snippet (drop into CMS): {"cta_free":{"label":"Try Redwood API","href":"/signup?utm=launch"},"cta_demo":{"label":"Request a Demo","href":"/enterprise/demo?utm=launch"}}

rebecca: legal ok with 'median' phrasing once prashant's link is public. also remove any absolute claims about guarantees.

prashant: ops replied with public method link: https://perf.redwood-inference/benchmarks/launch-method-public

content-bot: Editorial checklist reminder: add SEO meta, OG image, and alt text (see wiki).

nina: timeline: if legal + design deliver by 5pm I'll merge and schedule 10am PT next Thursday. tagging design and ops.

ux: design will export hero sizes by 2pm.

nina: great — closing loop: prashant to confirm public link (done), oliver to push CTA mapping to CMS, legal to finalize copy (rebecca), design to export. I'll merge if all clear by 5pm. :rocket:
